text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though my senior's warning lingers in my mind... unable to
forget that fleeting flash of brilliance she showed, I keep watching North Flight—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Flight-saaan!
Save meeee!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: What's the matter today, Yukino-chan?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san invited me to an "exhibition"...!
I mean, I'm suuuuuper happy about it, but... still~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You have no idea what kind of fashion to wear, right?
In that case, could you picture what's inside your closet for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as it had once been done for her, North Flight was offering
fashion advice to all sorts of horsegirls. What's more—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaah, I see!
So I just need to lower my posture when I run!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That way, you can firmly engage your lower limbs.
It'll make a noticeable difference when running uphill, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Flight, you really know your stuff!
Allllriiiiiight!! Here I goooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, Ticket-san... She's already all the way over there.
...Now then, time to stretch, stretch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight seemed well-versed not just in fashion, but in all
kinds of practical knowledge, and many friends relied on her whenever I looked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket just now... she is entering her prime, and word is
she'll be debuting soon. Her body looks race-ready, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet North Flight merely repeats simple stretches and conditioning
at the edge of the track. It seems true that she can't place strain on her body.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, alright.
Maybe I'll go for a little run?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I have been waiting for you, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appearing with boundless energy was Sakura Bakushin O... the
talk-of-the-town speedster who debuted this year. High hopes ride on her sprint career.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan... Um, I'm sorry.
Did we have plans or something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No! The idea just popped into my head, so I decided I had been waiting for you!
—Now, face me in a duel, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I simply cannot overlook your Bakushin aura!
Please, show me! Show me that exemplary speed of yours!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, deal! I want to check where I currently stand anyway...
Let's give it our all, Bakushin O-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At North Flight's suggestion, the impromptu duel was set at 1,400 meters—
a sprint distance. Which means... it will be a pure contest of speed.
choice_data_list: (If only Flight could go all out...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Here we, here we, here we go!
Let's keep up a stellar pace! BAKUSHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O takes the early lead, while behind her,
North Flight calmly bides her time... And as they enter the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight accelerates rapidly with breathtaking speed.
The moment she pulls level with Sakura Bakushin O, I catch myself—shouting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Victory is mine!
As expected, my speed is supremely! Exemplaryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sakura Bakushin O takes the win by a single length.
North Flight decelerated just before reaching top speed... exactly like last time.
choice_data_list: (So she really... can't go all out.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible, Bakushin O-chan.
Looks like your speed has been honed even further since your debut.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* That is because I train hard and run in plenty of races!
However, according to my Bakushin intuition, you are bound to become even faster!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... you're right. Someday...
Someday, I'll do my best to match your speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
2,000 meters before, and 1,400 meters this time...
Watching both runs reaffirmed her immense raw talent—and her boundless potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stamina to compete over medium distances, and the speed to
hold the crown in sprints... If she continues to grow from here—
choice_data_list: (She could even aim for a Triple Crown across all three divisions...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart races. Sprints, miles, medium distances...
An unprecedented challenge that defies distance aptitudes. She has the talent... but—

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: —That was close, North Flight.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Going toe-to-toe with Sakura Bakushin O who's already racing on the frontlines!
If only she could fully unleash that talent. Really, if only her body were stronger...
choice_data_list: (Right, if only her physical condition allowed it...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even an outsider like me feels that way. North Flight herself must feel
far more frustrated... Yet, having finished her run, there is no gloom about her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day... strolling through town lost in thought,
I spot the clothing boutique where I had gone shopping with North Flight before.
choice_data_list: (Picking out clothes was so much fun.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reach out to an outdoor hanger rack.
Recalling her words, I think about what styles would suit me best.
choice_data_list: (Bringing out the best in the raw material, huh—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for today, Onee-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning toward the familiar voice, I see North Flight.
In front of her stands a gentle-looking woman. What catches my attention is—

text_block_list.name: "Onee-chan"
text_block_list.text:
I was really happy to see you after so long too, Fuu-chan.
You look so lively... I'm truly glad.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I'm doing great!
Just the other day, I had five whole bowls of rice. Five bowls, you know?

text_block_list.name: "Onee-chan"
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so?
You're working hard, such a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had always seen North Flight as an independent, dependable girl.
Yet right now, she looks so much more youthful and innocent than usual.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying my absolute best!
I promise I'll have wonderful news for you. Bye-bye, Onee-chan—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san?
